recap.text: Carl and the cat enter a plush blue room that rocks like a boat. Lexis, an associate producer with blonde hair in a tight bun and a voice like a cartoon, tells them her host wants an interview. Lexis briefs them to wave and go to the couch without meeting invisible walls. The cat asks about makeup and tone, and Lexis pushes Carl toward the set.

Lexis speaks for Odette and warns Carl that a repurposed human dressed as a queen waits to zero out crawlers at the top of the leaderboard. Lexis uses a vape pen that smells of burnt candy and watches a blinking cursor on her tablet. She says Odette would also advise going down the stairs early.

Lexis delivers a flat briefing stating the Open Intellect Action Network holds nearly every major ship in orbit and something unknown stands over the kinder facility. She stops mid-sentence upon receiving a message and shows fear. After the event, Lexis wipes her tablet on her sleeve and reports that ratings are the highest they have ever been while innards drip from her nose.

beats.headline: The production trailer
beats.text: Down the stairs, through a door like the first one, and out into a plush blue room that rocks like a boat and is not in the dungeon at all. Lexis comes in with a tablet: five and a half feet, thin the way her people are thin, blonde hair in a tight bun, plain black dress, and a light musical voice that sounds like a cartoon. Associate producer on a chat show, and also the first person from the far side of a camera either of them has met. Her host would love to interview them, on air. The cat takes to it at once. The man, who had his gauntlet out before the door opened, sits down with his head spinning.
beats.gist: Lexis, a thin associate producer with blonde hair in a bun, wants to interview the man and cat.

beats.headline: Blocking out the segment
beats.text: She briefs them at speed. This is a production trailer on the surface, still technically in the game, menus off. Walk on when told, wave, go straight to the couch, the cat nearer the host, and do not approach the audience or meet a wall you cannot see. Taped, tunnelled in a few hours, uncensored, and the more entertaining the better. The cat asks about makeup, about tone, about whether to let Carl be Carl, as if she has done this all her life, and the corner of Lexis's mouth very nearly smiles. Then she comes back, puts a hand on the man's back and pushes. Smile and wave.
beats.gist: Lexis briefs them in a production trailer on the surface.

beats.headline: A warning delivered on someone else's behalf
beats.text: Lexis speaks for Odette, because Odette cannot be the one saying it. What is waiting on this floor is a country boss dressed as a queen, and the queen is very likely a repurposed human. She does not know which human any more, now that Bea is off the board. She says the thing is built to zero out the crawlers at the top of the leaderboard, and when Carl says they will go down the stairs early, she says that would be Odette's advice as well. All of it comes at speed, in the minute the system is handing over control, with her eyes on a blinking cursor on her tablet and a vape pen that smells of burnt candy.
beats.gist: Lexis warns Carl for Odette about a repurposed human queen built to zero out top leaderboard crawlers.

beats.headline: The message she does not repeat
beats.text: Pre-show briefing before Plenty of Plenty, delivered flat, the way she delivers everything: nearly every major ship in orbit is now held by the Open Intellect Action Network, and something else has put down on the surface and is standing over the kinder facility, and nobody will say what it is. Then a message reaches her side of the room and she stops talking mid-sentence. I have kept a file on this woman since she first walked two crawlers onto a set and I have never once had cause to log her as afraid. I am logging it now.
beats.gist: Lexis delivers a flat briefing about the Open Intellect Action Network and a thing over the kinder facility.

beats.headline: The ratings, dripping
beats.text: When it is over, Lexis has a gun in her hand. She has not fired it. She returns it to a hidden holster on her back, picks her tablet up out of the gore, shakes it, wipes the screen on her sleeve and presses a button. She is covered worse than anyone in the room. The good news, she reports, with innards dripping from her nose, is that the ratings on this episode are the highest they have ever been.
beats.gist: Lexis wipes gore from her tablet and reports record ratings while innards drip from her nose.

relations.note: Associate producer, and the mouth Odette uses when Odette cannot be seen to speak.
